{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Logan Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of 4 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] used by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These fighters, along with [[Junker Squadron]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Yme Squadron]] attempted to protect [[Muurian transport]]s ''[[Botani]]'', and an [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttle]] ''[[Com 1]]'' from being captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]]. The fighters were all destroyed by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]], one of which piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], and the transports were captured.<ref name="CD-ROM">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter Collector's CD-ROM|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' Collector's CD-ROM]]</ref>
